Rise of the Quartron#000.src: I think I'll write an anonymous letter instead. If those rumors about the factory are true, keeping myself secret might be important...

Rise of the Quartron#001.src: Agh, this is getting worse! There's never been so much loss...whoever this is, they're getting bold...

Rise of the Quartron#002.src: Dado won't budge about the topic. Maybe Nasea has an idea to get him to confess.

Rise of the Quartron#003.src: Come back when you have a solid lead on the missing quartz.

Rise of the Quartron#004.src: You press the flower up against his nose while he's laughing. Dado gets a big whiff of the petals, and immediately his expression goes slack.

Rise of the Quartron#005.src: ...uh. Okay, I have no clue why I told you all of that...um, have you got any more of those flowers though? It was actually really good...

Rise of the Quartron#006.src: Use the small rail here, push that button on the post. It'll look like you're just...doing what humans do, instead of drawing suspicion.

similar.text: Use the small rail here, flick the lever. It'll look like you're just...doing what humans do, instead of drawing suspicion.

Rise of the Quartron#008.src: Aah, they're really tough!! Don't let them take down more of my buddies!

Rise of the Quartron#009.src: Why are we fighting face-to-face?! They're destroying us!!

Rise of the Quartron#010.src: What the hell are humans made of?! Overwhelm them!! We hardly have any guys left!

Rise of the Quartron#011.src: The door is locked. There has to be a way to get in...

Rise of the Quartron#012.src: Looks like someone's notebook. You open to a page that looks interesting...

Rise of the Quartron#013.src: I've finally cracked it- a functional model for my magnum opus, the Harnort Quartron! I even amaze myself, yes yes!

Rise of the Quartron#014.src: The mech is both made of and has functions to break apart quartz. We'll be able to salvage every bit from the rubble of {p}'s committee building...

Rise of the Quartron#015.src: The fools in the committee will see their error when their rooms get blown apart in front of them! They'll see my brilliance!

Rise of the Quartron#016.src: Large-scale mechs that even Corkus's machines pale in comparison to, the possibilities for them are so much more than just warfare...

Rise of the Quartron#017.src: But my subordinates need to hurry with the quartz shipments. The Karoc manager may catch onto us if we don't...and I regret thieving enough already.

Rise of the Quartron#018.src: The quartz is charged! Use this to overcharge the door and destroy it!

Rise of the Quartron#019.src: There's a charging slot in the machine.

Rise of the Quartron#020.src: The door is locked shut, and there's no keyhole anyplace.

Rise of the Quartron#021.src: It's made of quartz, it looks like...the sign says not to overcharge the quartz.

Rise of the Quartron#022.src: Nasea mentioned that overcharging quartz was dangerous...maybe overcharging the door will destroy it.

Rise of the Quartron#023.src: Is there a way to charge quartz anyplace nearby?

Rise of the Quartron#024.src: ...so it's come to this then. I knew the names of all those guards. I didn't hurt anyone to meet my goal.
Rise of the Quartron#024.dst: ...así que hemos llegado a esto. Me sabía los nombres de todos esos guardias. No hice daño a nadie para lograr mi meta.

Rise of the Quartron#025.src: One life for a hundred is a fair trade!!

Rise of the Quartron#026.src: Aaah! Not responding?! You- You...YOU! You've destroyed the future! MY future! GAVEL'S future!!!
Rise of the Quartron#026.dst: ¡Aaah! ¡¿No responde?! Tú- Tú... ¡TÚ! ¡Has destruido el futuro! ¡MI futuro! ¡¡¡El futuro de GAVEL!!!

Rise of the Quartron#027.src: ...you've got some serious explaining to do. First you disappear to go get that Tattle flower, or whatever it was.

Rise of the Quartron#028.src: Then Dado ran through here screaming that he was drugged or mugged, and ran off to the east ridge.

Rise of the Quartron#029.src: ...uh huh. Mhm. ... ...yeah, go on. Uh, okay, I can buy that... ...I'd never believe you if you hadn't given me the proof.
Rise of the Quartron#029.dst: ...ajá. Mmm. ... ...sí, sigue. Eh, vale, me lo puedo creer... Nunca te creería si no me hubieras dado la prueba.

Rise of the Quartron#030.src: Okay, so I'll cut you a quick deal. I'll pay you now for figuring this out, and if you do just one more thing for me then you'll get something extra.

Rise of the Quartron#032.src: Shipment {~}A and {~}B, fully accounted for... shipments {~}C and {~}A...missing {~} of quartz content?!
Rise of the Quartron#032.dst: Envío {~}A y {~}B, todo cuadra... envíos {~}C y {~}A... ¡¿faltan {~} de cuarzo?!
Rise of the Quartron#032.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#033.src: Agh, this is getting worse! There's never been so much loss...whoever this is, thy're getting bold...
Rise of the Quartron#033.dst: ¡Agh, esto va a peor! Nunca se había perdido tanto... quienquiera que sea, se está envalentonando...
Rise of the Quartron#033.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#034.src: Ugh, go AWAY! Quit hovering over my shoulder like that- wait, a Human? Since when did you get here?
Rise of the Quartron#034.dst: ¡Uf, LARGO! Deja de rondarme por encima del hombro- espera, ¿un humano? ¿Desde cuándo estás aquí?
Rise of the Quartron#034.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#035.src: What, you like listening to the melodious sound of my voice or something? Or do you intend to help out?
Rise of the Quartron#035.dst: ¿Qué pasa, te gusta escuchar el melodioso sonido de mi voz o qué? ¿O es que piensas ayudar?
Rise of the Quartron#035.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#036.src: Well, I'm flattered either way, and I could certainly use the help. Quartz is going missing from my shipments.
Rise of the Quartron#036.dst: Bueno, en cualquier caso me halaga, y desde luego me vendría bien la ayuda. De mis envíos desaparece cuarzo.
Rise of the Quartron#036.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#037.src: Obviously one of the laborers is siphoning it to someplace, and I can't have that happening. So, be a private eye, humie.
Rise of the Quartron#037.dst: Está claro que alguno de los obreros lo desvía a alguna parte, y eso no lo puedo consentir. Así que hazte el detective, humanito.
Rise of the Quartron#037.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#038.src: This is actually pretty dire- quartz has some magicality to it, see. It likes to soak up magic power, which means it can be weaponized.
Rise of the Quartron#038.dst: La cosa es bastante grave- el cuarzo tiene algo de mágico, ¿sabes? Le gusta absorber poder mágico, así que se puede convertir en arma.
Rise of the Quartron#038.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#039.src: We tend not to use it for weapons since it can overcharge, but that's neither here nor there, is it?
Rise of the Quartron#039.dst: No solemos usarlo para armas porque puede sobrecargarse, pero eso ahora da igual, ¿no?
Rise of the Quartron#039.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#040.src: Every siphoned shipment has gone through Dado. Interrogate him! He hangs out past the big red tent, near the house with red flags.
Rise of the Quartron#040.dst: Todos los envíos desviados han pasado por Dado. ¡Interrógalo! Anda por detrás de la carpa roja grande, cerca de la casa de las banderas rojas.
Rise of the Quartron#040.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#041.src: Talk to Dado and see if he is the culprit.
Rise of the Quartron#041.dst: Habla con Dado y averigua si es el culpable.

Rise of the Quartron#042.src: Okay, these go to division P, and...look, I'm busy allocating these deliveries to {p}. Go pester someone else, okay?
Rise of the Quartron#042.dst: Vale, esto va a la división P, y... mira, estoy ocupado repartiendo estos envíos a {p}. Vete a dar la lata a otro, ¿vale?
Rise of the Quartron#042.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#043.src: ...what. You...think I... Pfff... Pffhahaaaah! Ohhh, that's RICH coming from a human of all things!
Rise of the Quartron#043.dst: ...qué. ¿Crees... que yo...? Pfff... ¡Pfjajajaaa! ¡Ohhh, qué GRACIA viniendo justo de un humano!
Rise of the Quartron#043.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#044.src: "Oh, me, the hired gun species that kills for money, will accuse you, a storied worker of seven years, of illegal activity!" Wow, you HYPOCRITE!
Rise of the Quartron#044.dst: "Oh, yo, de la especie mercenaria que mata por dinero, ¡te acuso a ti, con siete años de trabajo a las espaldas, de actividad ilegal!" ¡Vaya, qué HIPÓCRITA!
Rise of the Quartron#044.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#045.src: I'm hardly even angry about this! But, yeah, you freak. You got the wrong guy, surprise! Your brain workin' right in there?
Rise of the Quartron#045.dst: ¡Si es que ni me enfado! Pero sí, pirado. Te has equivocado de tío, ¡sorpresa! ¿Te funciona bien el coco ahí dentro?
Rise of the Quartron#045.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#046.src: I bet you got some wires crossed in there, huh? Go scuttle on back to town and kill someone's Wybel for pocket change or something.
Rise of the Quartron#046.dst: Seguro que tienes los cables cruzados, ¿eh? Vuelve corriendo al pueblo y mata el Wybel de alguien por cuatro monedas o lo que sea.
Rise of the Quartron#046.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#047.src: Go back to Nasea and tell her about Dado’s response.
Rise of the Quartron#047.dst: Vuelve con Nasea y cuéntale la respuesta de Dado.

Rise of the Quartron#048.src: I'm just going to take a wild guess and say that asking him nicely whether he committed theft didn't bring up any answers.
Rise of the Quartron#048.dst: Me arriesgo a adivinar: preguntarle por las buenas si había robado no dio ninguna respuesta.
Rise of the Quartron#048.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#049.src: What, he brushed you off like THAT? Jeez, I knew he was a jerk, but really? That's just uncalled for.
Rise of the Quartron#049.dst: ¿Qué, te despachó ASÍ? Jolín, sabía que era un capullo, pero ¿en serio? Eso ya es pasarse.
Rise of the Quartron#049.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#050.src: We have to make him talk...if shipments keep going missing, my contractors are going to look elsewhere!
Rise of the Quartron#050.dst: Hay que hacerlo hablar... ¡si los envíos siguen desapareciendo, mis clientes se irán a otra parte!
Rise of the Quartron#050.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#051.src: We need to prove that he's guilty...wait, you came to ME for ideas? This is why I asked you for help! Am I really back to square one?
Rise of the Quartron#051.dst: Tenemos que demostrar que es culpable... espera, ¿has venido a pedirme ideas a MÍ? ¡Para eso te pedí ayuda! ¿En serio vuelvo a la casilla de salida?
Rise of the Quartron#051.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#053.src: I...what are you doing here, uh...Larry? Were you missing quartz too??
Rise of the Quartron#053.dst: Yo... ¿qué haces aquí, eh... Larry? ¿A ti también te falta cuarzo??
Rise of the Quartron#053.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#054.src: Ah, it's...Lari. No, the quartz shipment found its way fine...
Rise of the Quartron#054.dst: Ah, es... Lari. No, el envío de cuarzo llegó bien...
Rise of the Quartron#054.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#055.src: But, there was hardly an effect. Your idea was, unfortunately, a dead end.
Rise of the Quartron#055.dst: Pero apenas tuvo efecto. Su idea, por desgracia, no llevó a nada.
Rise of the Quartron#055.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#056.src: Well, I did warn you that it was only an idea. I manage the mine, I don't practice purification magic. Don't pin anything on me for that.
Rise of the Quartron#056.dst: Oye, ya te avisé de que era solo una idea. Yo dirijo la mina, no practico magia de purificación. No me eches nada en cara por eso.
Rise of the Quartron#056.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#057.src: I did not intend to imply that. Your help was appreciated, fate simply had opposing plans...
Rise of the Quartron#057.dst: No pretendía insinuar eso. Agradezco su ayuda; el destino sencillamente tenía otros planes...
Rise of the Quartron#057.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#058.src: ...is this human a part of your operations, miss?
Rise of the Quartron#058.dst: ...¿este humano forma parte de sus operaciones, señorita?
Rise of the Quartron#058.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#059.src: Well, in a sense. Someone's siphoning quartz, but our suspect wasn't intimidated by the ten tons of armor, so we're at a loss. Any ideas?
Rise of the Quartron#059.dst: Bueno, en cierto sentido. Alguien desvía cuarzo, pero al sospechoso no lo intimidaron diez toneladas de armadura, así que estamos atascados. ¿Alguna idea?
Rise of the Quartron#059.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#060.src: ...as a matter of fact, I do have a solution. Elven botany describes a flower that grows decently close by, the "Tattytale" flower.
Rise of the Quartron#060.dst: ...de hecho, sí tengo una solución. La botánica élfica describe una flor que crece bastante cerca: la flor "Tattytale".
Rise of the Quartron#060.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#061.src: It weakens the will of those who catch a whiff of its petals, making them pliable to questions. It's...unpleasant, but if it is needed, I suppose.
Rise of the Quartron#061.dst: Debilita la voluntad de quien huele sus pétalos y lo vuelve dócil a las preguntas. Es... desagradable, pero si hace falta, en fin.
Rise of the Quartron#061.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#062.src: There is a cave infested with spiders, and covered with webs in the western mountain. It is the only place it grows outside of {p}, unfortunately.
Rise of the Quartron#062.dst: En la montaña occidental hay una cueva infestada de arañas y cubierta de telarañas. Por desgracia, es el único sitio donde crece fuera de {p}.
Rise of the Quartron#062.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#063.src: Nasea, since it didn't help, I've returned the quartz. I thank you for your help...and I shall bid you both adieu.
Rise of the Quartron#063.dst: Nasea, como no sirvió, he devuelto el cuarzo. Le agradezco su ayuda... y me despido de ambos.
Rise of the Quartron#063.speaker: Lari

Rise of the Quartron#065.src: Make Dado confess by using the Tattytale Flower.
Rise of the Quartron#065.dst: Haz confesar a Dado usando la flor Tattytale.

Rise of the Quartron#066.src: Hey, everyone's least-favorite attack dog! Here boy! You want the emerald? Go kill all the flies in my house! Come on boy!
Rise of the Quartron#066.dst: ¡Eh, el perro de presa que menos gusta a todos! ¡Ven aquí, chico! ¿Quieres la esmeralda? ¡Ve a matar todas las moscas de mi casa! ¡Venga, chico!
Rise of the Quartron#066.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#067.src: Aw, flowers. How sweet of you! Sorry, but I don't cave to psychopaths or flattery, hehehee!
Rise of the Quartron#067.dst: Ay, flores. ¡Qué detalle! Lo siento, pero yo no me rindo ante psicópatas ni halagos, ¡jejejé!
Rise of the Quartron#067.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#068.src: I...huff... What was THAT for?! Are you offended that I don't like your flo- What? What am I doing with the quartz?
Rise of the Quartron#068.dst: Yo... uf... ¡¿A qué ha venido ESO?! ¿Te ofende que no me gusten tus flo- ¿Qué? ¿Que qué hago con el cuarzo?
Rise of the Quartron#068.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#069.src: Uh, isn't it obvious? I'm working overtime and sending it up to Popo, duh. Where else would I be sending it?
Rise of the Quartron#069.dst: Eh, ¿no es obvio? Hago horas extra y se lo mando arriba a Popo, obvio. ¿Adónde si no?
Rise of the Quartron#069.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#070.src: What- Where's Popo sending it? Um...no clue. Whoever it is, they're super rich though. They pay me more than my house is worth every shipment!
Rise of the Quartron#070.dst: Qué- ¿Adónde lo manda Popo? Eh... ni idea. Pero quienquiera que sea, es rico de narices. ¡Me paga más de lo que vale mi casa por cada envío!
Rise of the Quartron#070.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#071.src: Not sure why you need to- What? Where's Popo? Uh, he said he'd meet me at the cart track overpass, near the teal flags.
Rise of the Quartron#071.dst: No sé para qué- ¿Qué? ¿Popo? Dijo que me vería en el paso elevado de las vías, junto a las banderas turquesa.
Rise of the Quartron#071.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#072.src: This was going to be our first meeting, so I don't know what he looks like, and likewise he's never seen me.
Rise of the Quartron#072.dst: Iba a ser nuestro primer encuentro, así que no sé qué pinta tiene, y él tampoco me ha visto nunca.
Rise of the Quartron#072.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#073.src: ...uh. Okay, I haave no clue why I told you all of that...um, have you got any more of those flowers though? It was actually really good...
Rise of the Quartron#073.dst: ...eh. Vale, no tengoo ni idea de por qué te he contado todo eso... oye, ¿te quedan más de esas flores? La verdad es que estaba muy bien...
Rise of the Quartron#073.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#074.src: Go up the minecart hill and find Popo.
Rise of the Quartron#074.dst: Sube la cuesta de las vagonetas y encuentra a Popo.

Rise of the Quartron#075.src: Ah, you must- Wait, never mind. I was expecting a visit from someone else.
Rise of the Quartron#075.dst: Ah, tú debes de- Espera, déjalo. Esperaba la visita de otro.
Rise of the Quartron#075.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#076.src: Wait, you're Dado? I guess humans have more brain capacity than orcs after all, hehah!
Rise of the Quartron#076.dst: Espera, ¿tú eres Dado? Parece que los humanos tienen más cerebro que los orcos, ¡jejá!
Rise of the Quartron#076.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#077.src: Okay, down to business. I'm gonna look busy to cover for you while you get to the base for briefing. You'll get the details there.
Rise of the Quartron#077.dst: Vale, al lío. Yo haré como que estoy ocupado para cubrirte mientras llegas a la base a por las instrucciones. Allí te darán los detalles.
Rise of the Quartron#077.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#078.src: You stick out like a sore thumb, but thankfully humans like to get into lots of weird spots, so it won't look too out of place.
Rise of the Quartron#078.dst: Cantas más que un pollo, pero por suerte a los humanos les gusta meterse en sitios raros, así que no desentonará demasiado.
Rise of the Quartron#078.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#079.src: Use the small rail here, flick the lever. It'll look like you're just...doing what humans do, instead of drawing suspicion.
Rise of the Quartron#079.dst: Usa la vía pequeña y acciona la palanca. Parecerá que solo... haces cosas de humanos, sin levantar sospechas.
Rise of the Quartron#079.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#080.src: Ride the minecart to the bandit mansion.
Rise of the Quartron#080.dst: Viaja en la vagoneta hasta la mansión de los bandidos.

Rise of the Quartron#081.src: Hop on the minecart, it's leaving! But act natural!
Rise of the Quartron#081.dst: ¡Sube a la vagoneta, que se va! ¡Pero disimula!
Rise of the Quartron#081.speaker: Popo

Rise of the Quartron#082.src: Interesting, a human's been swept up in our plans. Hadn't expected the work force to diversify so fast.
Rise of the Quartron#082.dst: Interesante, un humano metido en nuestros planes. No esperaba que la plantilla se diversificara tan rápido.
Rise of the Quartron#082.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#083.src: Time for the rundown, oh I love explaining this! I think you'll find what I have to say quite interesting, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#083.dst: Hora del resumen, ¡ay, cómo me gusta explicar esto! Creo que lo que voy a contarte te parecerá bastante interesante, ¡sí, sí!
Rise of the Quartron#083.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#084.src: You see, quartz is a powerful magical material- moreso than many know! It can absorb and harness magical energy, but what more? I had to find out!
Rise of the Quartron#084.dst: Verás, el cuarzo es un material mágico poderoso- ¡más de lo que muchos saben! Puede absorber y canalizar energía mágica, pero ¿qué más? ¡Tenía que averiguarlo!
Rise of the Quartron#084.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#085.src: The rubes in my research department got me kicked out for suggesting we further our research. What kind of scientist is scared to make advancements?!
Rise of the Quartron#085.dst: Los zoquetes de mi departamento hicieron que me echaran por proponer que lleváramos más lejos la investigación. ¡¿Qué clase de científico teme avanzar?!
Rise of the Quartron#085.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#086.src: But without a board of directors breathing down my neck, my research has led me exactly where I'd hoped, and even more, yes yes!
Rise of the Quartron#086.dst: Pero sin un consejo de administración respirándome en la nuca, mi investigación me ha llevado justo adonde esperaba, y aún más allá, ¡sí, sí!
Rise of the Quartron#086.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#087.src: Oi. Got a guest taking the secret passage.
Rise of the Quartron#087.dst: Eh. Tenemos un invitado por el pasadizo secreto.
Rise of the Quartron#087.speaker: Guard

Rise of the Quartron#089.src: Harnort! I'M Dado! This sicko mugged me for info! They're gonna ruin us both!
Rise of the Quartron#089.dst: ¡Harnort! ¡Dado soy YO! ¡Este pirado me sacó la info! ¡Nos hundirá a los dos!
Rise of the Quartron#089.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#090.src: Guards!! GUARDS!! Capture them! Stop them! Tie them up, do something!! Our research can't go to waste, not at this vital point!!
Rise of the Quartron#090.dst: ¡¡Guardias!! ¡¡GUARDIAS!! ¡Atrapadlos! ¡Detenedlos! ¡¡Atadlos, haced algo!! Nuestra investigación no puede echarse a perder, ¡¡no en un punto tan crucial!!
Rise of the Quartron#090.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#091.src: HA! That's what you get for showing me that amazi- HORRIBLE flower! Outta here!
Rise of the Quartron#091.dst: ¡JA! ¡Por enseñarme esa flor tan increí- HORRIBLE! ¡Yo me piro!
Rise of the Quartron#091.speaker: Dado

Rise of the Quartron#092.src: Break into the laboratory and stop Harnort.
Rise of the Quartron#092.dst: Irrumpe en el laboratorio y detén a Harnort.

Rise of the Quartron#094.src: You...I won't let their sacrifices be in vain! {p} needs to see what quartz is truly capable of! I MUST show them.
Rise of the Quartron#094.dst: Tú... ¡No dejaré que su sacrificio sea en vano! ¡{p} tiene que ver de lo que es capaz el cuarzo! DEBO enseñárselo.
Rise of the Quartron#094.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#095.src: My Quartrons are the future! They need to see it! It will have been worth the scheming, and the thieving, and the burnt bridges!
Rise of the Quartron#095.dst: ¡Mis Quartron son el futuro! ¡Tienen que verlo! ¡Habrán valido la pena las intrigas, los robos y los puentes quemados!
Rise of the Quartron#095.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#096.src: But you- you couldn't leave well enough alone. You stepped in, and callously threw away a hundred lives to stop the inevitable!
Rise of the Quartron#096.dst: Pero tú- tú no podías dejarlo estar. ¡Te metiste y tiraste sin piedad cien vidas por la borda para frenar lo inevitable!
Rise of the Quartron#096.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#097.src: One live for a hundred is a fair trade!!
Rise of the Quartron#097.dst: ¡¡Una vida por cien es un trato justo!!
Rise of the Quartron#097.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#098.src: Take down the Quartron and return to nasea with the news.
Rise of the Quartron#098.dst: Derriba al Quartron y vuelve con Nasea con la noticia.

Rise of the Quartron#100.src: The futures of a hundred men or more!! You humans deserve to burn in hell for your careless destruction!
Rise of the Quartron#100.dst: ¡¡El futuro de cien hombres o más!! ¡Los humanos merecéis arder en el infierno por vuestra destrucción insensata!
Rise of the Quartron#100.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#101.src: The energy output by the detonations is overcharging the quartz in the walls... This entire lab is a deathtrap now! Do us all a favor- SIT STILL AND DIE ALREADY!!
Rise of the Quartron#101.dst: La energía de las detonaciones sobrecarga el cuarzo de los muros... ¡Este laboratorio es ya una trampa mortal! Haznos un favor- ¡¡ESTATE QUIETO Y MUÉRETE YA!!
Rise of the Quartron#101.speaker: Harnort

Rise of the Quartron#102.src: ...you've got some serious explaining to do. First you disappear to get that Tattle flower, or whatever it was.
Rise of the Quartron#102.dst: ...tienes muchísimo que explicar. Primero desapareces a por esa flor Tattle, o como se llamara.
Rise of the Quartron#102.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#103.src: Then Dado ran through here screaming that he was drugged or nugged, and ran off to the east ridge.
Rise of the Quartron#103.dst: Luego Dado pasó por aquí gritando que lo habían drogado o drugado, y salió corriendo hacia la loma del este.
Rise of the Quartron#103.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#104.src: Then, he came back, asking me if I'd found any more of those flowers, and while he was blabbering the ENTIRE MOUNTAIN SHOOK.
Rise of the Quartron#104.dst: Después volvió a preguntarme si había encontrado más de esas flores, y mientras farfullaba TODA LA MONTAÑA TEMBLÓ.
Rise of the Quartron#104.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#105.src: So, spill it. I wanted you to figure out where my quartz was going, and you made one of my workers an addict and caused a freaking landslide!!
Rise of the Quartron#105.dst: Así que suéltalo. Te pedí que averiguaras adónde iba mi cuarzo, ¡¡y has vuelto adicto a uno de mis obreros y provocado un dichoso desprendimiento!!
Rise of the Quartron#105.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#107.src: A militarized quartz mech...yeesh. That guy sounds like a piece of work. Guess that wasn't really your fault after all.
Rise of the Quartron#107.dst: Un mecha de cuarzo militarizado... uf. Vaya elemento ese tipo. Supongo que al final no fue culpa tuya.
Rise of the Quartron#107.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#108.src: I'll round up the police to get all those guards and them. ...what's with that look? Almost looks like you don't think anyone'll be there. Anyways...
Rise of the Quartron#108.dst: Reuniré a la policía para que detengan a esos guardias y a él. ...¿a qué viene esa cara? Casi parece que crees que no habrá nadie. En fin...
Rise of the Quartron#108.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#109.src: Okay, so I'll out you a quick deal. I'll pay you now for figuring this out, and if you do justt one more thing for me then you'll get something extra.
Rise of the Quartron#109.dst: Vale, te propongo un trato rápido. Te pago ya por haberlo resuelto, y si haces una cosita más por mí, te llevas algo extra.
Rise of the Quartron#109.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#110.src: Take the elevator past the yellow flags and go into the private site, you have my permission. I'll meet you up there.
Rise of the Quartron#110.dst: Coge el ascensor tras las banderas amarillas y entra en la zona privada. Tienes mi permiso. Nos vemos arriba.
Rise of the Quartron#110.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#111.src: Join Nasea at the end of the minecart track.
Rise of the Quartron#111.dst: Reúnete con Nasea al final de las vías de las vagonetas.

Rise of the Quartron#113.src: This is the newest mining annex, but we've hit a bit of a brick wall. Well...a gravel wall.
Rise of the Quartron#113.dst: Este es el anexo minero más nuevo, pero nos hemos topado con un muro. Bueno... con un muro de grava.
Rise of the Quartron#113.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#114.src: So, if you can open up this area, you'll get access to the mine and whatever you find in it.
Rise of the Quartron#114.dst: Así que, si puedes abrir esta zona, tendrás acceso a la mina y a lo que encuentres en ella.
Rise of the Quartron#114.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#115.src: I have to be off though, lots of work to get to. Hm. It looks like the core you showed me folded up into a ring. Really high-tech stuff, but I can't use it, so you can take it.
Rise of the Quartron#115.dst: Pero yo tengo que irme, me espera mucho trabajo. Hm. Parece que el núcleo que me enseñaste se ha plegado en forma de anillo. Pura alta tecnología, pero no puedo usarlo, así que quédatelo.
Rise of the Quartron#115.speaker: Nasea

Rise of the Quartron#116.src: Suppose that's all, then! Here's your payment. I'll see you around.
Rise of the Quartron#116.dst: ¡Pues supongo que esto es todo! Aquí tienes tu paga. Nos vemos.
Rise of the Quartron#116.speaker: Nasea
